ChildMinutesLst.Title: A. 25-26 SPED Contractual Agencies Request
ChildMinutesLst.Minutes: Motion to approve the Interim Superintendent's recommendation for the 2025-2026 SY to  use multiple partnerships with contractual agencies for students with IEPs who are served in private or public separate day facilities.

MeetingOnlineVotings.Minutes: Motion to approve the Interim Superintendent's recommendation for the 2025-2026 SY to  use multiple partnerships with contractual agencies for students with IEPs who are served in private or public separate day facilities.

ChildMinutesLst.Title: B. 25-26 CCVI Educational Consultant Agreement
ChildMinutesLst.Minutes: Motion to approve the use of CCVI Educational Consultant Agreement for support services for individual Student’s evaluation results and the planned intervention goals on Student’s Individualized Education Programs (IEP).

MeetingOnlineVotings.Minutes: Motion to approve the use of CCVI Educational Consultant Agreement for support services for individual Student’s evaluation results and the planned intervention goals on Student’s Individualized Education Programs (IEP).

ChildMinutesLst.Title: C. Speech-Language Pathologist (SLP) Stipend Proposal
ChildMinutesLst.Minutes: Motion to approve The Interim Superintendent and Assistant Superintendent of Student and Special services recommendation to establish a stipend for district-employed speech-language pathologists (SLPs) who have, or are working toward, their Certificate of Clinical Competence (CCCs).

MeetingOnlineVotings.Minutes: Motion to approve The Interim Superintendent and Assistant Superintendent of Student and Special services recommendation to establish a stipend for district-employed speech-language pathologists (SLPs) who have, or are working toward, their Certificate of Clinical Competence (CCCs).

ChildMinutesLst.Title: D. Bus Route Approvals
ChildMinutesLst.Minutes: Motion to approve the finalized 2024 -2025 school year bus routes.

MeetingOnlineVotings.Minutes: Motion to approve the finalized 2024 -2025 school year bus routes.

ChildMinutesLst.Title: E. Food Agreement with American Dining
ChildMinutesLst.Minutes: Motion to approve the Interim Superintendent's recommendation that the district accept the Amendment to renew the fixed price food service agreement with American Food and Vending for a term of one-year effective July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026.

MeetingOnlineVotings.Minutes: Motion to approve the Interim Superintendent's recommendation that the district accept the Amendment to renew the fixed price food service agreement with American Food and Vending for a term of one-year effective July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026.

ChildMinutesLst.Title: F. CMS Sidewalk
ChildMinutesLst.Minutes: Motion to approve the Interim Superintendent's recommendation to approve the contract with Huston Contracting, Inc. to proceed with the removal and replacement of the concrete sidewalks at Center Middle School at an estimated amount of $14,940.00 with contingencies not to exceed 10%.

ChildMinutesLst.Title: M. New Flexible Furniture at Center Middle School
ChildMinutesLst.Minutes: Motion to approve the recommendation to purchase flexible furniture for Center Middle School with a total cost of approximately $58,460.36.  Funding would be $43,436.93 from Title I funds for the flexible collaboration tables and soft seating, and $15,023.43 would be from district funds for chairs and a teacher desk.

ChildMinutesLst.Title: R. Auditing Services
ChildMinutesLst.Minutes:
Motion by Roady was seconded by Boydston to approve the Interim Superintendent's recommendation for a three-year contract with KPM CPAs & Advisors to provide annual audit services for FY2025, FY2026, and FY2027 at a total cost of $91,800.
Motion failed 0-1-6. 

Motion by Ball was not seconded, to obtain clarification with Westbrook audit to determine the audit services contract to provide clarity of pre-approval of additional charges and justification for the charges in performance of the audit proposed.  The motion was retracted.  

Motion Sarver was seconded by Fritz to allow Dr. Hogg to speak to Westbrook & Co. regarding their proposed audit services contract and add a provision requiring pre-approval of costs above their original agreed upon price. This information will be communicated to the board for a future vote regarding the contact.
Motion carried 7-0-0.

MeetingOnlineVotings.Minutes:
Motion by Roady was seconded by Boydston to approve the Interim Superintendent's recommendation for a three-year contract with KPM CPAs & Advisors to provide annual audit services for FY2025, FY2026, and FY2027 at a total cost of $91,800.
Motion failed 0-1-6. 

Motion by Ball was not seconded, to obtain clarification with Westbrook audit to determine the audit services contract to provide clarity of pre-approval of additional charges and justification for the charges in performance of the audit proposed.  The motion was retracted.  

Motion Sarver was seconded by Fritz to allow Dr. Hogg to speak to Westbrook & Co. regarding their proposed audit services contract and add a provision requiring pre-approval of costs above their original agreed upon price. This information will be communicated to the board for a future vote regarding the contact.
Motion carried 7-0-0.
